author: unknown
content:
PSA: If your Steam downloads instantly fail with a fresh install, and you had configured the client to use external storage before downloading anything, try disabling external storage in the GameNative settings and installing your first game to internal storage
See title. After I installed a game to internal storage, I was able to re-enable external storage and download more games without issue. I was having trouble figuring out the problem initially, and couldn't find anything mentioning this trick here so I figured I would post this in case it helps anyone else.
